rationale: Despite a bounce off the $25.12 session low that briefly pushed the last print to $26.19 above VWAP ($26.04), price remains well below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($26.59) and our $26.85 invalidation level. Crucially, the current bid-ask spread has blown out to 297.8 bps ($25.87 x $26.65), meaning closing at market right now would force us to buy the $26.65 ask and realize nearly the maximum loss without our technical thesis actually breaking. Holding allows liquidity to normalize and tests whether sellers defend the 9-EMA resistance on this post-earnings gap down.
